description: Single-file Zettelkasten notes: create/edit notes with markdown-ish text and [[wiki-links]], automatic backlinks panel, tag management, full-text search, force-directed graph of note connections on canvas with click-to-open, localStorage persistence with seeded demo graph.

criteria: zettel_notes_model_01.html is one self-contained Zettelkasten (no libraries): notes created and edited with a title, body and tags where [[Wiki-Links]] in the body resolve to other notes and auto-create backlinks shown in a backlinks panel for the open note, broken links visibly marked, full-text search across titles, bodies and tags with result ranking or highlighting, a tags sidebar with filtering, and an interactive canvas graph where notes are nodes and links are edges laid out by a real force-directed simulation that can be dragged, with click opening the note and the current note highlighted. Persistence in localStorage with a seeded demo graph of at least 8 connected notes on first run.
